description: This file defines an interface 'IBasketQueryService' in C#, which provides a method to asynchronously retrieve the count of total basket items for a specific user, without running in-memory queries.

classes.name: IBasketQueryService
classes.description: An interface for querying basket item counts for users.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the total number of basket items for a given username.
